title: Bayesian Transfer Operators in Reproducing Kernel Hilbert Spaces
abstract: arXiv:2509.22482v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Transfer operators provide a linear description of nonlinear dynamical systems by propagating observables or probability distributions. In reproducing kernel Hilbert spaces, these operators are represented through conditional mean embeddings, whose regularized estimator coincides with the posterior mean of Gaussian process regression. Building on this correspondence, we formulate Gaussian Process Dynamic Mode Decomposition, a Bayesian transfer-operator method that combines sparse variational Gaussian processes with kernel-based Koopman and Perron--Frobenius operator approximation. The resulting framework provides a principled route to uncertainty quantification, scalable sparse approximations, and data-adaptive dictionary learning for prediction and spectral analysis. translated_title: 再生核希尔伯特空间中的贝叶斯转移算子
translated_abstract: 转移算子通过传播观测量或概率分布，为非线性动力系统提供了一种线性描述。在再生核希尔伯特空间中，这些算子通过条件均值嵌入来表示，其正则化估计量与高斯过程回归的后验均值相一致。基于这一对应关系，我们提出了高斯过程动态模态分解，这是一种贝叶斯转移算子方法，它将稀疏变分高斯过程与基于核的Koopman算子和Perron–Frobenius算子近似相结合。所得到的框架为不确定性量化、可扩展的稀疏近似以及面向预测与谱分析的数据自适应字典学习提供了一条有原则的途径。此外，该模型选择公式自然地产生了前向–后向算子结构，从而建立了贝叶斯转移算子
tldr: 该论文提出高斯过程动态模态分解（GP-DMD），一种将稀疏变分高斯过程与基于核的Koopman及Perron–Frobenius算子近似相结合的贝叶斯转移算子框架，可同时实现不确定性量化、可扩展的稀疏近似和数据自适应字典学习。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes Gaussian Process Dynamic Mode Decomposition, a Bayesian transfer-operator framework that combines sparse variational Gaussian processes with kernel-based Koopman and Perron–Frobenius operator approximation, enabling principled uncertainty quantification, scalable sparse approximation, and data-adaptive dictionary learning for prediction and spectral analysis.
